summary: Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass covering health, NDIS codes, invoice CRUD + auto-computed totals/GST/status toggle, receipt CRUD, task CRUD with date filter, dashboard stats, /api/scan-receipt (real GPT-4o vision extraction on synthesized PNG receipt) and /api/transcribe (real Whisper on gTTS-generated MP3). Frontend (mobile web, 390x844): Dashboard renders metrics + 4 quick actions + today's timeline; navigation to New Invoice works; NDIS hot-key picker works; all 5 tabs load (Command/Invoices/Receipts/Planner/Scan); Planner add-task modal saves and task appears; Receipts filter chips (8) present; Scan shows camera permission prompt (expected on web); Invoices list shows card and Mark Paid button. Fixed one backend bug during test run (see updated_files).

minor.issue: Accepts arbitrary body (dict) with no validation; could allow overwrite of protected fields like id/created_at. Consider a strict TaskUpdate Pydantic model.
No enum validation on status value; accepts any string. Should restrict to 'paid'|'unpaid'.
invoice_number based on count_documents is not race-safe and does not survive deletions (collisions possible). Consider an atomic counter or UUID.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Enable Camera' primary button appears with excessive height (fills large portion of screen) on web preview - style likely missing explicit height or has flex:1 causing it to stretch. Minor cosmetic on web; validate on device.

issues: React Native Web deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but should be migrated.

action_items: Consider tightening PATCH endpoints with Pydantic update models (status enum, task fields)
Fix Enable Camera button size on scan screen (add explicit width/padding instead of flex:1)
Migrate deprecated shadow*/pointerEvents style props to modern RN Web equivalents
critical_code_review_comments: server.py compute_invoice_totals mutates input item.amount in place (side effect) - acceptable but note
Invoice number generation via count_documents is not concurrency-safe
scan-receipt: JSON parse is resilient (strips ``` fences, extracts { .. }) - good
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Fixed OpenAI Whisper 'file' argument: OpenAISpeechToText.transcribe now receives Path(tmp_path) instead of raw string (previous raw string caused 500: 'Expected entry at file to be bytes, io.IOBase, PathLike or tuple, got str'). Verified with real gTTS MP3 -> 200 OK.
/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py - Created full pytest suite (11 tests) with real image + real speech AI tests, module-scoped cleanup
seed_data_creation: Test invoice 'Sarah M' INV-1001 ($222.95) and task 'UI Test Task' created during UI test; test data cleaned up by pytest fixture on backend tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://careworker-dash.preview.emergentagent.com). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Frontend needs mobile viewport (390x844). All testIDs are present per (tabs)/*.tsx and invoice/new.tsx. Scan screen on web only shows permission prompt (grant-camera-btn) - capture button requires device.
rca_of_issue: Whisper 500 root cause: emergentintegrations.OpenAISpeechToText.transcribe internally forwards `file=` to OpenAI SDK which requires bytes/IO/PathLike, not str. Fix: wrap tmp_path with pathlib.Path before passing.
